values./system/biography: A Nuka-World advertising eyebot driven haywire by the Robot Command Pulser.
values./items/@d41ed81f26aed8b0/system/descript: Body + Guns (TN 8), Stun, Range C, Fire Rate 1.
values./items/@81305fa6a289dd86/system/descript: This character is a robot: it cannot use consumables or heal naturally, and damage must be repaired. It is immune to hunger, thirst and suffocation.
values./items/@18b78419da274802/system/descript: This character cannot suffer damage or effects from radiation.
values./items/@1854f9e4aabf0b0e/system/descript: This character cannot suffer damage or effects from poison.
values./items/@6971bc1cc1a9b8a6/system/descript: At 2 HP or fewer it self-destructs for 3 DC Energy damage with Radioactive and Blast.
values./items/@38b9debf6c4e1397/system/descript: Non-robots within Close increase the difficulty of PER tests by 1.
values./items/@806b8714b8068c71/system/descript: It is slain by any hit that inflicts an Injury.
